name: Middlesex County, NJ
findings: Middlesex County has 2,516 nonprofit organizations. 1,043 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 828 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Middlesex County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 215 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 215 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list civic or political action. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
